hints.title: Joining Orders with Products and Customers
hints.text: Join Orders with Product to compute the spent revenue for each purchased quantity, and link with Customers.

hints.title: Conditional Monthly Spending Aggregation
hints.text: use conditional case statements inside sum to aggregate spend separately for June 2020 and July 2020.

hints.title: Filtering Customer Cohorts
hints.text: group by customer_id and name. filter in having where both June spend is at least 100 and July spend is at least 100.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT c.customer_id, c.name
FROM Customers c
JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN Product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2020-06-01' AND o.order_date <= '2020-06-30' THEN o.quantity * p.price ELSE 0 END) >= 100
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2020-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2020-07-31' THEN o.quantity * p.price ELSE 0 END) >= 100;
```

complexity.notes: Single pass join and group by aggregation over orders evaluating conditional sums.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Separate queries for June and July require subquery joins or intersections when conditional aggregation resolves in one pass.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Conditional summation inside having avoids materializing intermediate tables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Conditional summation inside having clause over calendar intervals.

solutions.code:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.name
FROM Customers c
JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN Product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2020-06-01' AND o.order_date <= '2020-06-30' THEN o.quantity * p.price ELSE 0 END) >= 100
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2020-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2020-07-31' THEN o.quantity * p.price ELSE 0 END) >= 100;

SELECT c.customer_id, c.name
FROM Customers c
JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN Product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2020-06-01' AND o.order_date <= '2020-06-30' THEN o.quantity * p.price ELSE 0 END) >= 100
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2020-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2020-07-31' THEN o.quantity * p.price ELSE 0 END) >= 100;

import pandas as pd

def customer_order_frequency(customers: pd.DataFrame, product: pd.DataFrame, orders: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = orders.merge(product, on='product_id').merge(customers, on='customer_id')
    df['spend'] = df['quantity'] * df['price']
    df['order_date'] = df['order_date'].astype(str)
    june = df[df['order_date'].str.startswith('2020-06')].groupby(['customer_id', 'name'])['spend'].sum().reset_index()
    june_qualified = june[june['spend'] >= 100]['customer_id']
    july = df[df['order_date'].str.startswith('2020-07')].groupby(['customer_id', 'name'])['spend'].sum().reset_index()
    july_qualified = july[july['spend'] >= 100]['customer_id']
    common = set(june_qualified).intersection(set(july_qualified))
    res = customers[customers['customer_id'].isin(common)][['customer_id', 'name']]
    return res
